transport.name: KakaoMap / Naver Map
transport.use: Bus, subway and train routing with live arrivals (Google Maps transit is limited in Korea)

transport.name: KORAIL Talk
transport.use: Book KTX / ITX / Mugunghwa trains, e.g. Busan to Gyeongju

transport.name: Kakao T
transport.use: Taxi hailing; supports foreign cards for registered users

transport.name: T-money card
transport.use: Rechargeable transit card for buses and subways, also usable at convenience stores

navigation.name: Naver Map
navigation.use: Most accurate maps in Korea, English UI, bicycle-path layer

navigation.name: Komoot / Ride with GPS / Strava
navigation.use: Cycling route guidance and recording; download GPX/offline maps in advance

navigation.name: Papago
navigation.use: Naver's translator for menus and signs

payment.name: Visa / Mastercard credit card
payment.use: Accepted almost everywhere; contactless works at most shops

payment.name: Apple Pay / Google Pay
payment.use: Growing acceptance, but not at every merchant; carry a physical card

payment.name: Kakao Pay / Naver Pay
payment.use: Common locally; foreign-card linking is limited, so do not rely on it

payment.name: Cash (KRW) + T-money
payment.use: Needed for some markets and rural stalls; withdraw at convenience-store ATMs (GS25/CU/7-Eleven)

payment.name: Wise
payment.use: Low-fee card and currency exchange for travellers
